currentWork.title: FINAL.33 arrival visit cards, bidirectional visit swipe, and fullscreen MAP software rotation
currentWork.releaseStatus: Implementation is validated on PR #164 and awaits merge/production verification. FINAL.32 remains the previous production release until merge.
scope: Accurate GPS fixes (accuracy <=50m) within 100m of the route destination automatically end the in-app route.
Arrival opens one vending-machine card at a time: destination first when unvisited, then other unvisited machines on today's plan within 100m.
Arrival cards and standard Today cards use left swipe for visit complete and right swipe for today's visit skip.
Visit completion reuses the existing task confirmation and order confirmation flow; arrival does not bypass either.
Normal app and normal MAP no longer show the blocking landscape portrait guard; portrait orientation is requested where supported and the web-app manifest prefers portrait.
Fullscreen MAP adds a fullscreen-only software rotate button (🔄) that rotates the MAP 90 degrees without requiring OS orientation unlock.
Fullscreen PIN interaction and modal stacking remain preserved.
